question: Do you supply cleanroom consumables?
html:
Cleanroom consumables at Thomas Scientific

Cleanroom is a category we are building toward. The information available here does not confirm which cleanroom consumables we stock today, so please check the live catalogue or ask your account representative for current availability.

What we can confirm

  • Cleanroom is one of the specialty verticals in our growth plan, alongside cannabis testing, cold chain and forensics (Thomas Scientific growth plan, Oct 6, 2026).
  • The plan includes a possible West Coast cleanroom or life-science tuck-in by month 36. That would take us from 10 to 11 distribution centers (est.; the plan calls this an assumption, not a forecast).
  • The wider plan adds punchout ordering, vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and private label. These would apply to specialty categories such as cleanroom as they roll out (Thomas Scientific growth plan).

What we cannot confirm yet

  • Which cleanroom items are in stock today. Examples would be wipes, garments, gloves or swabs.
  • Lead times, cleanliness classes supported, or the brands we carry in this category.
  • Data that would answer this:
  • the current product catalogue by category
  • trailing cleanroom category sales
  • active supplier agreements

  4. Keep any cleanroom acquisition sequenced behind the refinancing, as the plan requires.
